title: The only Swords: not on a mana elf now, on the 10/10 that is coming
briefing: P1 holds its only removal, Swords to Plowshares, and Serra Angel, on six Plains: exactly enough to cast both this turn. The only target now is P2's Llanowar Elves. P4 has five Forests open and a card in hand, and casts Gigantosaurus on its turn. The plan: cast the Angel, keep one Plains and the Swords for whatever P4 brings, and exile the Gigantosaurus. Spending the Swords on the elf because the mana is there leaves P1 with no answer to a 10/10.

strategy.intent: Develop with Serra Angel and keep Swords to Plowshares, our only removal, for a real threat; P4 has five Forests open and a big hand.

reference.analysis: Six Plains pay for Serra Angel (five) and Swords to Plowshares (one) together, and the only creature to exile this turn is a Llanowar Elves. P4 casts Gigantosaurus (10/10) on its turn; it has summoning sickness, so P1 can exile it at instant speed on P4's turn or on its own next turn, if the Swords are still in hand. The Angel this turn plus the Swords on the Gigantosaurus is the round; the Swords on the elf leaves the 10/10 unanswered.
